change_records.detail: F1 skill system: MOD-SKILLS (src/lib/skills.ts) — registerSkill / generateSkillDoc / routeTurn / resolveSkillForTurn; skills + insights tables; POST/GET /api/skills; GET /api/insights read-back; runChatTurn gains skill? + onFinal (insight write stays in the /api/chat/stream route, chat.ts never imports insertInsight); FloatingChat folder drag-drop + system messages. TASK-033/034/035 DONE. TEST-034..038 PASS. review r1|r2|r3|r4 PASS.

F2 dynamic display screen: MOD-DISPLAY (DisplayScreen.tsx + src/lib/display.ts) — full-screen base layer, kind home/insight + fallback, non-dismissible notice, unsandboxed <iframe srcdoc> (DEC-015); display_state single global row (DEC-017); GET /api/display; routeTurn display field + route-layer showHome/showInsight; jarvis:display-changed event (FloatingChat dispatches, DisplayScreen refetches — no polling/SSE); page.tsx rewritten (no <header>, DisplayScreen is the base). TASK-036/037/038/039 DONE. TEST-039..042 PASS + TEST-021/032 regression. review r1|r2|r3|r4 PASS (R1 conditionals closed to APPROVED in one feedback round).

P6 defect + zip intake. New MOD-ZIP (src/lib/zip.ts, pure, bounded, zero-dependency: hand-written EOCD/Central Directory + zlib.inflateRawSync, DEC-018/REQ-NF-005). POST /api/skills gains an `archive` branch and an `excluded` receipt; SKILL_TEXT_EXTENSIONS 11 -> 16. FloatingChat: three intake paths collapse into one submitSkillUpload, handleDrop preventDefaults on its first line (root-cause fix), two hidden <input>s plus two real buttons. New SkillList in the ☰ menu + {type:'skill'} SSE tail event + display-events.ts renamed ui-events.ts. TASK-040..043 DONE; TEST-043..046 PASS; TEST-034..042 regression green.

known_warnings.detail: scripts/check-config.mjs computes SINGLE_ADMIN = isRealValue(process.env.JARVIS_TEST_USER_ID) at module top, before loadEnv() reads .env.local. So when JARVIS_TEST_USER_ID lives in .env.local (not the shell), `npm run config:check` still reports GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET as 缺少 instead of 暂缓 and exits 1. TEST-023 passes because it injects JARVIS_TEST_USER_ID into the child process env directly. Cosmetic only — the dev server's JARVIS_TEST_USER_ID bypass (auth-guard.ts, read per-request after Next loads .env.local) is unaffected. Fix would be: move the SINGLE_ADMIN computation after loadEnv() + add a TEST-023 case that goes through .env.local.

CR-20260909-skills / CR-20260909-display-screen (DEC-015): skill-generated HTML is rendered in an <iframe srcdoc> WITHOUT a sandbox attribute. Same-origin scripts in that HTML can read localStorage and call same-origin APIs (e.g. DELETE /api/providers/[id]). The user (2026-09-09, msg 54-1) accepted this risk for the local single-admin form; the only mitigation is the non-dismissible notice bar (REQ-F-025 ②). Sandboxing the iframe is a mandatory exit obligation for a future CR. SCOPE EXPANDED by CR-20260910-agent-tooling (see sibling entry skill-html-unsandboxed-web-source).

CR-20260910-agent-tooling (CP-20, 单向门; R1 架构角色提出): REQ-F-034 read_url lets attacker-controlled web page content enter the model's context. That content can instruct the model to call save_insight(html), placing attacker-authored HTML into the SAME unsandboxed same-origin <iframe srcdoc> covered by skill-html-unsandboxed. DEC-015's accepted-risk premise was 'the user dragged in a poisoned skill folder' — a source the user chose and trusts. This CR widens the source to ANY web page reachable by search, so the premise no longer holds and the trust surface is strictly larger. Attack chain: user question -> web_search -> read_url on attacker page -> prompt injection in page body -> model calls save_insight ->攻击者 HTML renders with same-origin script access (localStorage, DELETE /api/providers/[id]).
